title: bmo-agency API
what: The calls the receiver makes on bmo-agency: agents and their roads, a session's start, turn, push, state, fold and end, the rest and its stand-in, a room forgotten, companions, a run's log and reset point, and the agency's events.

title: bmo-brain API
what: The calls the receiver makes on bmo-brain: a room's rules, the reminders the send tool sets, a session's loaded documents, a chat session's handoff note, a room's person book, the rows a turn wrote, and a room forgotten or removed.

title: bmo-chat provider API
what: The provider routes of bmo-chat's protocol that the receiver calls through bmo-chat-client: a declaration, health, sends, message files, dialect readings and checks, the room routes and the owner.

title: bmo-gate API
what: The calls the receiver makes on bmo-gate: a turn's reference chosen from the envelope, the sanitiser on the way in and out, a room's judgements, and a companion's gate options copied from the chat agent's.

title: bmo-job API
what: The calls the receiver makes on bmo-job: a room's holdings, the questions a job puts to the owner, the items a turn filed, and the queue a turn moved.

title: bmo-cache-warmer API
what: The calls the receiver makes on bmo-cache-warmer: the consumer registered with its chat-touch hook as one target, and the target told each time a turn used the session.

title: bmo-web API
what: The calls the receiver makes on bmo-web: the account model, a sender's user, a user and its senders, the grants and relations in a room, and a fixed line rendered in the rooms' language.
